## Rule

**Dodge-lines (proven 200k/200k closed-form, 2026-06-07).** Grid is always 10×10, colors {0,2,5}. Each `2` in the bottom row (row 9) grows a vertical line upward. At the lowest `5`-obstacle in its column (row r), the line sidesteps one column RIGHT at row r+1 (sidestep cell `(r+1, c+1)` is marked too) and continues upward in column c+1 to row 0. Obstacles persist in the output; obstacles not in a line's column are untouched.

Corpus invariants (verified on all 200k ARC-GEN pairs, `Logs/` + session 2026-06-07):
- input `2`s confined to row 9; 2–4 line columns; line columns never adjacent (min separation 2)
- ≤1 obstacle per column, obstacle rows only 2..6, 1–3 obstacles per grid
- every line dodges at most ONCE (no double-dodge, no off-grid dodge, dodged path never hits a second obstacle, sidestep cell never an obstacle)
- CLASS-CHECK: LIVE truth full = 200,000/200,000 → clean class; gold gate = visible + truth-full + ab-byte-equal

## Algorithm sketch

```python
# m1(c) = r_low+1 of the (unique) obstacle in col c, else 0
m1 = (o * (r+1)).sum(axis=rows)          # sum == max because <=1 obstacle/col
own   = b[c] & (r+1 >  m1[c])            # b = bottom-row 2s; full column when m1=0
g     = shift_right(m1 * b); g1 = g + (g > 0)        # g1 = m1(c-1)+1 gated
dodge = (r+1) <= g1[c]                   # covers sidestep row + rows above
out: ch2 = own | dodge, ch5 = o, ch0 = ~(ch2 | ch5), rest 0
```

LIVE 11,069 (mem 10,934 + params 135): crops [1,10,10,10] F32 (4,000 B) + F16 compute planes + 17 inits.

**v4 = 887 is the enumerated floor zone (2026-06-07 drive, target was <1,000 / stretch <700).** Final-op family enumeration (#68) for this content:
- **BitwiseAnd class-LUT (v3/v4 family): 887–925.** Irreducible items, each priced: einsum [1,1,1,30] F32 120 B (width 30 + F32 forced by `input`); i32 class-bit plumbing 160 B (cast 40 + Gather 40 + width-30 Pad 120 — Gather idx must be ≥int32, traps); u8 vec chain ~180 B; slice 40 B; **A_lut 300p irreducible**: params count dense elements (sparse inits scorer-fatal, core.md), and the 17 reachable classes exceed i16's 16 bits by exactly one (merging line-no-obs into a virtual dodge-g1=10 class does NOT reduce the bit count — recounted 17), so i32 stands.
- **Plane-tail (v1 family): floor ~1,630** — 600 B [1,6,10,10] BOOL concat is forced (Pad is the only cheap channel-embedder; Conv-as-channel-mixer needs F16 input = same 600 B + cast tax; einsum-as-Pad costs 660p of mixer matrices), + ≥600 B of mask planes.
- **Equal-tail (v2 family): ~1,000 floor** — 900 B u8 30×30 pad + 100 B canvas, or 1,000 B pad-after one-hot. task360 v7's pad-after-at-width-4 trick doesn't transfer: our active region is the full 10×10.

Burning a submit slot on a §39 probe would only confirm the source-read.

## Don't-do log

- **Broadcast-Add tail (#67 256-style) is DEAD here**: ch5 is an arbitrary 10×10 scatter (not rank-1), and ch2's per-column intervals are mixed-direction (bottom-up [m1+1,10] for line cols, top-down [1,g1] for dodge cols) → not a nested level-set family → not expressible as `A[ch,r]+B[ch,c] > 0`. Priced dead 2026-06-07.
- **BitwiseAnd-intersection tail with COMPUTED A is DEAD** (ch5-scatter blocker) — **but the INIT-LUT variant WINS** (v3/v4): when A is an initializer LUT over column classes, there is no rank limit; the blocker only applies when both operands must be computed/rank-1. Don't re-dismiss the family.
- **Sub-700 enumeration (2026-06-07, "drive under 1000/700" push): DEAD across all families** — full pricing in Cost analysis. Most tempting retries that are already dead: CP/MatMul-final (factor ≥1,200 B), Conv-final coded canvas (pad-collision ⇒ ones-channel ⇒ 600 B), i16 LUT (17 classes > 16 bits), BitShift-for-Gather (−34p only), §39 dynamic probes (grader source-read: repricing is up-only).
- **OneHot tail is DEAD**: OneHot indices must be int32/int64 → [1,1,30,30] indices = 3,600 B ≫ 900 B u8 pad.
- **Equal-tail loses to Concat-tail by ~300 B in v1's bool-plane formulation** (w2+canvas+pad900 = 1,100 vs bg+ch0+z+concat = 901). Equal-tail only wins when planes aren't already BOOL (v2).
- **u8-wraparound single-compare interval form (would-be v3) REJECTED**: merges own+dodge into one compare via mod-256 trick, saves only ~50 B (+0.03 pts) but makes correctness depend on the line-separation≥2 invariant (v1's Or-union is walker-exact for ANY input). Not worth the robustness loss.
- **Gather/LUT per-column-pattern formulation DEAD**: 84+ reachable column keys × 60 output bits ≥ 5,040 params.
- Don't slice ch5 rows [1:9] to save 80 B — the canvas/plane re-pad eats the saving exactly.
